title: APEify
description: A character tracking and progression app.
longDescription: APEify is a character tracking and progression app that allows users to manage their character data, save progress via Firebase, and interact with a premium UI. It features Google AdMob integration and a robust privacy policy.

title: Germy
description: An interactive experience involving germ-themed graphics.
longDescription: Germy provides an interactive experience centered around germ-themed graphics and animations. It includes a dedicated privacy policy and is designed for a smooth user experience.

title: Ten Beer Plan
description: A plan-based application for social activities.
longDescription: Ten Beer Plan helps users organize and track social plans. It features a clean interface and specifically focuses on ease of use for social coordination.

title: Project Alpha
description: Revolutionizing specific workflow with automated insights.
longDescription: A conceptual tool designed to automate insights for a specific workflow, gauging interest for a potential MVP.
